title: Time-Weighted Average Price
scenario: Calculate the time-weighted average price for each product from the first recorded date to 2019-09-01.
tableSchema: products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE)
hint: Use native date subtraction in PostgreSQL.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, SUM(new_price * duration) * 1.0 / SUM(duration) AS twa_price FROM (SELECT product_id, new_price, (LEAD(change_date, 1, '2019-09-01'::date) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY change_date) - change_date) AS duration FROM products) t GROUP BY product_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE);
